bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，仍低于 $399–405

read.en: Applied Materials rose 6.1% on Nov 11 to $395.08, trading $381.75–404.71. It is above the 5-day ($358.0) and 10-day ($372.8) and below the 30-day ($427.8), 100-day ($492.2) and 200-day ($446.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, still below zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($316.95), and RSI is 47.6.

The rally cleared the $372.8–375.5 zone and the $382.1–390.1 highs, now support; the $404.71 high stopped at the $399–405 band (Nov 2 high). Resistance is $399.2–404.7, then $411.5 (Sep 16 low) and $426.1–427.8 (Sep 3 low, 30-day). Support is $381.8–390.1 (Nov 11 low, Oct 30 close), then $372.5–375.5 (10-day) and $358 (5-day). A close above $404.7 would target $411.5; below $381.8, $372.5–375.5.
